data.keyword: What's the best payroll software for a small business?

result.keyword: What's the best payroll software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For a small business in Australia, I'd shortlist **Xero, MYOB, KeyPay (now Employment Hero Payroll), and QuickBooks**\.

The best choice depends on how many employees you have, whether you need to manage award rates and overtime, and whether you already use accounting software.

My general recommendation is **Xero Payroll for a small business that wants simple, integrated payroll**, but there are situations where another platform is a better fit.

## Best payroll software compared

Australian pricing and features, November 2026

![Free High-Quality xero logo png for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/9qnwxOObu7ODCnjvtZS3OrO0aEo-O6ZxoDMA_BgXWHmpclDvIBWhiiFc7sv2CSwP8u7lVkQexj-2Q6JwX6bLCkmQGBaOEFUaRc4WBhsOFHNZO-ImlbOxfjscA06CBlmqvsyW9qGAz0ywS1dS_FiB_uxDnV6_EbbsbiPoLuJHAA6MH09EB8jLexW7FAqo1iFu?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Xero Payroll**

(Best overall for simplicity)

- Payroll integrated with accounting.
- Employee payslips, leave and timesheets.
- STP Phase 2 and super processing.
- Starts at approximately \$37/month, with employee limits by plan.
  
  Best if you already use Xero.
  
  [Xero website](https://www.xero.com/au/)

---

![MYOB - Features, Reviews & Pricing (February 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RSnJXDEAckMg49Z3Uyl1ySpGe5Mf5xY-fiHvWrkutyMlRVsk_cizHWnHbb0_8J0spngX92NOecbYb0xtPztOW_1U5_j589rcfR6e_7DzDwZO-F8qM8BNDHiplH9bI1r3qal9-SnHWVHGyS5SP06Y1atDJc1eUMWI1ht7KCGJtRhy8le1UHOPMDyYDZIt-Ehu?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. MYOB**

(Best for value)

- Australian payroll and accounting integration.
- Employee management and reporting.
- Timesheets and rostering on eligible plans.
- Business Pro approximately \$70/month plus employee payroll charges.
  
  Good for businesses wanting accounting and payroll together.
  
  [MYOB website](https://www.myob.com/au)

---

![Employment Hero - Which HR Software](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hoOMaIHHE1BVK8wWyswfFUWF-4zNLm2VTTf8I0IsZi71QvwwVg013JN6PZd_JzmKlLo5GMH1Nn9Dlq8Awe3_MYWQTya_RX2YJlpU2kxq0LmTpktkVrYam4C6Jqjid1iaOedcQ7rhD-uZbRDBcKqCEBszhJOC_eRUB4bTTF7gnOKcGZ7dKIuzDzdg-ruuRgJy?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Employment Hero Payroll**

(Best for award-based employees)

- Modern award interpretation.
- Rostering, timesheets and employee management.
- Helpful for hospitality, retail and shift workers.
- Payroll plans start around \$100/month due to minimum user requirements.
  
  Best when payroll complexity is more important than price.
  
  [Employment Hero website](https://employmenthero.com/au/)

---

![Reckon Payroll 2026 Pricing, Features, Reviews & Alternatives | GetApp](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ACef1V9QbM8Y3LxjLzJIQV-TfChUBjwyyx7W6AOhVMywuWusbhYulcZYBn3S8A-J1ZSIIaQtu8WMi3CVnQm3fE7mKMbBw3Beo_sQTtWxx5CDDP34nqzqL6m70W1jmud24Hdj0BDI4_JPvo8A-h8b5n6w-92zDw-PxjtUuoZZ2u15XApkZg7xxx4sYiZVnXkz?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Reckon Payroll**

- Straightforward standalone payroll.
- Budget-friendly.
- Plans from approximately \$16/month for up to four employees.
  
  Good if you don't need a full accounting package.
  
  [Reckon website](https://www.reckon.com/au/)

---

![](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/v2DxdxtjjvEmcT175Hs6YVBjgbAAlKMZDR6USs-77ApdWW6sbAFow9cQJv_MT97jB9zjE3wPxOpKSO9gcLLxLfFypeZvyP5eJvDL5WGyfBsSIqIhU81GbrWMoq4pqjRGs2-V3Eb0qoi-t3xsMSUPgetkp-nB9-Vn5YkmqvxZsrEUOfyJgwiq9_ZT3tLhuZte?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Payroller**

- Simple payroll for micro businesses.
- STP reporting.
- Low-cost employee-based pricing.
- Paid plans from approximately \$3.99 per employee/month on annual billing.
  
  Good for one to four employees.
  
  [Payroller website](https://payroller.com.au/)

Pricing is indicative and subject to plan limits and changes. Sources: [australiansmallbusiness.com.au](https://australiansmallbusiness.com.au/software/best-payroll-software-australia?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.testnotes.com.au](https://www.testnotes.com.au/best-payroll-software-australia?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.techrepublic.com](https://www.techrepublic.com/article/how-to-manage-outage-communications-optus-incident/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

| Your business situation | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| 1–5 employees, straightforward wages | Xero |
| Want inexpensive standalone payroll | Reckon |
| Hospitality, retail or shift workers | Employment Hero |
| Already using MYOB | MYOB |
| Just starting out, 1–4 employees | Payroller |


One important Australian consideration: make sure the software supports STP Phase 2, correct award interpretation where applicable, and payday super obligations.
